name: howto
title: The Dreo space heater in five minutes
sub: From the Dreo support page for the DR-HSH004, in order
footer: Sources: Dreo support page for DR-HSH004 (Oct 15, 2026); CPSC news release (Jan 23, 2026). The manual PDF itself could not be read.

items.head: Wall outlet only
items.body: No extension cord or power strip; a shared outlet can trip.

items.head: Place it flat
items.body: On a hard, level floor, 3 ft from anything that burns.

items.head: Pick a mode
items.body: ECO stops heating at the set temperature.

items.head: Aim the oscillation
items.body: 70° sweep; it pauses in ECO once warm.

items.head: Clean each season
items.body: Unplug, cool, dry cloth only: no detergents.
